name: After § 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of Vukovar
part_text: 6a. Underlines that ethnically motivated violence, discrimination and hate speech must be strongly condemned, irrespective of the ethnicity of the victims; calls on the Croatian authorities to ensure the effective investigation and prosecution of such incidents, strengthen the protection of national minorities and take decisive measures to promote tolerance, mutual respect and reconciliation;
